sloka: ततः शाखान्तरे लीनं दृष्ट्वा चलितमानसा ।वेष्टितार्जुनवस्त्रं तं विद्युत्सङ्घातपिङ्गलम् ।। ५.३२.१।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ śākhāntare līnaṁ dṛṣṭvā calitamānasā ।veṣṭitārjunavastraṁ taṁ vidyutsaṅghātapiṅgalam ।। 5.32.1।।।।

translations.english: Sita got perplexed on seeing him (Hanuman), who was tawny in complexion and looked like a cluster of lightnings, clad in white and hidden in between the branches.
